newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azerbaijan has new, five pct import duty from July.
newsitem.headline: Azerbaijan has new, five pct import duty from July.

text.p: Azerbaijan will levy a new import duty from July 1, a government spokesman said on Thursday.
He said the cabinet had approved a new, five percent tariff on goods brought in for so-called industrial needs, including metals, grains, lumber and railcars.
"This has been done to improve the tax system and has been recommended by the International Monetary Fund," State Customs Committee official Arif Gamzayev said.
The new tax does not concern items imported for use by registered foreign investors. The former Soviet republic taxes imports of other goods at 15 percent. --bilisi bureau, +995-32 999370
